fees.notes: Official UIS international fee for Ijazah Sarjana Pendidikan (Pendidikan Islam) (Masters of Education (Islamic Education)) (programme code mt15), last published on study.uis.edu.my (capture 20250122142920): RM14,440 total, an all-inclusive package covering registration, facilities & welfare, tuition & assessment, accommodation (Dormitory D, full-time only) and graduation. UIS's current programme page (https://study.uis.edu.my/mt15, accessed 2026-09-18) says tuition fee information will be updated soon, so this is the latest officially published international figure. fees.per_year = total / official duration. Source: https://web.archive.org/web/20250122142920/https://study.uis.edu.my/mt15.

requirements.other_qualifications: Bachelor degree with minimum 2nd Class Lower
